android.desc:
Provides various statistical data for Proto eligible matches.

⚽ Provides Historical Proto Match Data

You can easily check odds analysis results centered on match-betting. It is designed to allow you to view results relative to odds from past matches, rather than real-time match results or predictions, enabling you to intuitively grasp the correlation between odds trends and outcomes.

🔄 Provides Head-to-Head Analysis

We provide head-to-head data for specific match pairs to help users make decisions by referring to past trends.

⏳ 1-Day Free Demo

You can experience all features for free for one day upon your first login. After the demo period, you can continue using the service by extending the period.

🟢 No Ads / No Permissions

This app provides a clean UI without ads. It does not request separate device permissions.

Use with confidence.

⚠️ Important Note

This app is not designed to induce betting or provide result predictions.

Statistical data is provided for reference only and has no direct correlation with actual match results or investment profits/losses.

Some match information may contain errors due to the data collection process. Please be sure to verify accurate match information and official data through the official Sports Toto website or the Betman site.

quotes.text:
I am currently running an application in Korea that analyzes the results of sports Toto matches. I earn approximately $500–550 per month through in-app purchases.

This business model is somewhat limited, so I am considering other services.
